title: The Pilgrims — Coming to America for God
memory_verse: "Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever." — Psalm 107:1 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about the Pilgrims who came to America so they could worship God freely.
content: A long time ago, a group of people called the Pilgrims lived in England. They wanted to worship God in their own way, but they were not allowed to.
The Pilgrims were very brave. They sailed across the ocean on a ship called the Mayflower. The trip was long and hard, but they trusted God.
When the Pilgrims arrived in America, they thanked God for keeping them safe. Native Americans helped them learn to grow food in the new land.
The Pilgrims had a big feast to thank God for His blessings. We remember this as Thanksgiving! They show us the importance of thanking God for everything.
activity: Make a simple Mayflower ship out of a walnut shell, clay, and a paper sail. Act out the Pilgrims' journey.
discussion: Why did the Pilgrims come to America?
What is something you are thankful to God for?
Why is it important to have the freedom to worship God?
